description: Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine - Amendment of Section 1.1(A), 5.1, 5.2, 10.4.I(iii) and 11.1(A) of the Sri Lanka Nursing Service Minute published in the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1837/8 of 19.11.2013
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to the Sri Lanka Nursing Service Minute, which deals with public service recruitment, promotions, grade structures, and service conditions for nursing professionals. It is issued by the Ministry of Health and authorized by the Public Service Commission, making it clearly about public sector administration and service matters, falling under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8).
